text: A prince is also respected when he is either a true friend or a downright enemy, that is to say, when, without any reservation, he declares himself in favour of one party against the other; which course will always be more advantageous than standing neutral.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXI, How a prince should conduct himself so as to gain renown
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
